scope: Read-only product/source review of October 7 Report recovery/details, October 8 Staff/Template simplification, and the October 12 Staff focus fix, plus exact current-run phone screenshots. This is not the full release gate.

checks: Failed queued Report Retry/Recover actions appear before details and delegate the unchanged original record identity/captured answers/evidence to existing recovery and replay handlers; session, Worker, Department and connected-node guards remain.
The promoted action pair shares an in-flight guard. Expansion retains a single action set. Discard stays secondary in expanded details and delegates the existing confirmation and queue-lock path.

Report-only details keep answers, signatures, gallery access and final notes. A native details/summary disclosure carries capture/submission/reviewer/review timestamps; saved copies are labelled as device saves and cannot acquire a stale resolved note.

New Report-only Worker invitations explicitly keep normal as the retained class default. Existing-user edits omit worker_class; backend update_user reads model_fields_set and preserves the current class on omission, including a class changed after the editor opened.
Role, Department, self-account, pending-invitation and global-admin controls keep their existing policy. The full-interface override still exposes retained class management.

Template simple view hides field keys, unused conditions and new formula/repeat choices. Existing formulas, groups and conditions remain editable; load, draft restore and raw apply expose configured advanced behavior.

The advanced-options switch changes view state without Definition mutation or draft scheduling; the actual edit-form input listener explicitly excludes this checkbox, while ordinary field/name/description edits continue saving.

The only product asset changed after the October 8 feature commit is the reviewed synchronous focus fix in staff-sites.js; the source service-worker cache marker and regression checker also changed. Backend release commits introduced no frontend feature change.

The four delayed focus calls now run synchronously after panel visibility and button enabled state have changed. Existing focus eligibility, current-session and modal guards remain; no callback can steal a later Email/Search focus or affect a reopened panel.

Template draft continuation enables/reset its inputs before opening. Closing for session reset uses restoreFocus:false. Post-create focus remains conditional on successful creation, panel closure and focus still belonging to that panel/body, so a visible private invitation dialog retains its own focus.

The integrated actual-app regression holds animation-frame callbacks in one isolated browser context and checks newer Email/Search focus, correct typed field ownership, the intended created invitation identity, immediate opening focus and close/reopen safety.

The natural failure trace and deterministic old-module red/updated-module green evidence support the delayed-focus mechanism. The original first-dialog timeout and older historical invitation timeouts are not individually attributed.

Independently reviewed the test-only Template-library update: it checks visible/enabled initial Name focus with animation frames held, retains a later Description focus and correct field values when frames release, and still asserts no Template publication. It removes only the obsolete implementation-text match and requirement that focus be deferred; shared readiness checks remain.

focusDiagnosis.review: Reviewed the retained failure discriminator, controlled red/green, exact module/checker hashes and attribution limitations.

testOnlyFollowup.firstAttemptFailure: The 1e0be2a full gate stopped at an obsolete Template-library test that expected the removed delayed focus callback; exact failed proof and log are retained as local-focus-fix-first-attempt.json/.txt.

visualReview.freshness: All 14 archived screenshots were generated after the 1e0be2a mobile-run start and reviewed after its focused Report-detail/Staff/Template suites passed. The only later change in e6b38f9 is the reviewed Template-library test; all application source hashes and archived screenshot bytes remain identical, so this review binds them to e6b38f9 without regenerating images.
visualReview.reportDetails: Six 320px English/light and 390px Chinese/dark fixtures show readable full failure warnings, primary recovery actions before disclosure, full final-note access, signatures, six-photo previews with complete-gallery controls, More details and Supervisor PDF controls without clipping.
visualReview.templates: Four simple/configured-advanced 320px English/light and 390px Chinese/dark builder images show translated view controls, visible labels/inputs, preserved formulas and conditions, and no horizontal overflow.
visualReview.staff: Four actual-app viewport images at 320/390px English/light and Chinese/dark show Worker role, Department and private-invitation guidance without Worker-class controls. At 320px English the lower action area is below the screenshot fold; other captures show Create invitation and Cancel clearly.
